text:
**Best overall: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 with two 200 W solar panels.** It’s a close match to your target at **2,042 Wh**, with **2,200 W output** and **400 W of bundled panels**—a more substantial panel setup than a kit with just one 200 W panel. [Generator & Backup’s comparison](https://generatorandbackup.com/power-stations/best-solar-generators-home-backup) calls it the most complete solar backup kit.

If you’re comparing against Bluetti, the **BLUETTI Elite 200 V2** has **2,073.6 Wh** and **2,600 W output**; its two-panel 400 W bundle is listed at **$1,499**. [Dealectric’s kit comparison](https://dealectric.com/best-2000wh-solar-generator-kit-with-panels) also lists a cheaper one-panel version, but notes that a single 200 W panel may take **2–3 sunny days** to refill the battery.

judge.top_pick: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 + 2× 200 W Solar Panels
products: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 + 2× 200 W Solar Panels
